subject.title: [Feature]: Auto-discovery of agent configurations from external workspaces

question: Should OpenClaw add core trusted workspace-agent discovery, or keep agent registration explicit through `agents.list`, `openclaw agents add`, and `agents.create/update/delete`?
rationale: The requested feature adds new config surface, filesystem scanning, session routing effects, and security boundaries that cannot be safely chosen by cleanup automation.

options.title: Keep Explicit Registration
options.body: Continue relying on central config and explicit CLI/RPC agent management, while documenting operator scripts or plugins if needed.

options.title: Design Trusted Discovery
options.body: Define a core discovery contract with trusted roots, accepted filenames, precedence, schema validation, reload semantics, and security proof before implementation.

options.title: Narrow To Runtime Registration
options.body: Treat the main pain as zero-restart `agents.create/update/delete` behavior and leave glob discovery out of core for now.

recommendation.title: Keep Explicit Registration
recommendation.body: Continue relying on central config and explicit CLI/RPC agent management, while documenting operator scripts or plugins if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest current blame signal on the central agent config and gateway management paths at current main.
